# Sneed DAO app

> Sneed DAO builds open, permissionless tools on the Internet Computer: Sneed Lock (time-locking of ICRC-1 tokens and ICPSwap liquidity positions), a wallet, liquid staking helpers and more. This file lists the machine-readable documentation for integrators and agents.

## Canister API documentation

- [Sneed Lock canister API](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneed_lock.md): full reference for pqsms-lqaaa-aaaal-ajjza-cai, with flows, every method, error strings, types and JavaScript examples
- [Sneed Lock Candid interface](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneed_lock.did)
- [Sneed Lock JavaScript IDL factory](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneed_lock.did.js)

## Agent skills

- [Agent skills index](https://app.sneeddao.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): discovery index (schema 0.2.0)
- [sneed-lock skill](https://app.sneeddao.com/.well-known/agent-skills/sneed-lock/SKILL.md): compact, task-oriented guide to integrating Sneed Lock

## Source code

- [app_sneeddao on GitHub](https://github.com/Snassy-icp/app_sneeddao): canisters (Motoko) and the reference frontend (React)

## Optional

- [Human-readable API pages](https://app.sneeddao.com/api)
- [Help pages](https://app.sneeddao.com/help)
